name: Pairs distance trading — event-triggered
mechanism: pair rule, positions only in the 10 days after US payrolls day

name: Pairs distance trading — cross-sectional
mechanism: wider universe of formed pairs, only the most extreme divergences (k 2.5-3)

name: Pairs distance trading — time-series
mechanism: formed pairs; enter when spread z > k, exit when it crosses its formation mean or at window end

name: Pairs distance trading — lead-lag
mechanism: inside formed pairs: fade yesterday's 1-day divergence (laggard catches up)

name: Pairs distance trading — regime-conditioned
mechanism: pair rule only in calm / turbulent cross-asset vol regime

name: Pairs distance trading — term-structure
mechanism: pair rule gated by the 10y-3m curve sign

name: Pairs distance trading — flow-based
mechanism: pair rule only on days when total crypto volume is below its 20-day average (non-informational moves)

name: Pairs distance trading — volatility-based
mechanism: pair rule only when cross-sectional return dispersion is high / low

name: Pairs distance trading — execution-aware
mechanism: same rule but enter one day after the signal (removes bid-ask bounce, Gatev et al. robustness check)

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — event-triggered
mechanism: PCA residual s-score, only in the 10 days after payrolls

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — cross-sectional
mechanism: rank 5-day PCA-residual returns; long losers / short winners (dollar-neutral)

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — time-series
mechanism: Avellaneda-Lee: OU s-score of 60-day cumulative residual vs top-k PCs; enter |s|>s_in, exit |s|<0.5

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — lead-lag
mechanism: assets that under-reacted to yesterday's first-PC (market) move vs their beta catch up

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — regime-conditioned
mechanism: s-score rule in one vol regime

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — term-structure
mechanism: s-score rule gated by curve sign

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — flow-based
mechanism: s-score entries only on low-volume days for that coin (non-informational divergence, Llorente et al. 2002)

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — relative-value
mechanism: residual vs equal-weight universe mean (no PCA): fade N-day relative move

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — volatility-based
mechanism: s-score only when dispersion is high / low

name: Basket statistical arbitrage — execution-aware
mechanism: s-score rule entered one day late (bounce-robust)

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — event-triggered
mechanism: enter cash-and-carry for H days after the premium index jumps above 0.1%

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — cross-sectional
mechanism: hold cash-and-carry on the k coins with the highest 7-day funding (weekly)

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — time-series
mechanism: hold long spot / short perp while annualised trailing funding > th

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — lead-lag
mechanism: alt cash-and-carry only when BTC funding is above th (BTC leveraged demand leads alt basis)

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — regime-conditioned
mechanism: carry only when BTC is above / below its 200-day average

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — term-structure
mechanism: BTC/ETH: perp carry only when funding exceeds the quarterly basis (best venue for the carry)

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — flow-based
mechanism: carry only while open interest is rising (fresh leveraged longs keep funding positive)

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — relative-value
mechanism: always hold carry on whichever of BTC/ETH has the higher funding

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — volatility-based
mechanism: carry only when the coin's 30-day vol is below its 1-year median (basis blowouts happen in turmoil)

name: Crypto spot-perpetual basis — execution-aware
mechanism: carry with hysteresis: enter when funding > on, exit only below off (fewer round trips)

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — event-triggered
mechanism: always roll into the new quarterly right after expiry and hold the cash-and-carry for H days

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — cross-sectional
mechanism: hold the quarterly carry on whichever of BTC/ETH has the higher annualised basis

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — time-series
mechanism: long spot / short nearest quarterly while annualised basis > th

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — lead-lag
mechanism: rising perp funding leads the quarterly basis: enter carry when 7-day funding rose over the last week

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — regime-conditioned
mechanism: quarterly carry only in BTC calm / turbulent vol regime

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — term-structure
mechanism: quarterly carry only when its basis beats perp funding (term premium over spot carry)

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — flow-based
mechanism: quarterly carry only while perp open interest is rising

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — relative-value
mechanism: speculate on the basis itself: when its 90-day z-score > k short the basis (long future/short spot), < -k long it

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — volatility-based
mechanism: quarterly carry only when the coin's 30-day vol is below its median

name: Crypto dated-futures basis — execution-aware
mechanism: quarterly carry with hysteresis (enter > on, exit < 2%)

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — event-triggered
mechanism: large mint day (total USD stablecoin supply +k% in a day): long crypto for H days

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — cross-sectional
mechanism: when supply is growing, long high-beta alts vs BTC; when shrinking, the reverse

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — time-series
mechanism: long crypto when n-day stablecoin supply growth is positive, flat otherwise

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — time-series
mechanism: long crypto when n-day stablecoin supply growth is positive, flat otherwise

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — lead-lag
mechanism: supply growth leads prices by L days: signal is the growth from L+n to L days ago

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — regime-conditioned
mechanism: supply-growth rule only when BTC is above / below its 200-day average

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — term-structure
mechanism: supply acceleration: 7-day growth above the 90-day average daily pace -> long

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — flow-based
mechanism: supply growth and taker buying both positive -> long

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — relative-value
mechanism: ETH vs BTC: long ETH/short BTC when supply grows (new money goes further out the risk curve)

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — volatility-based
mechanism: supply-growth rule only when BTC vol is below / above its median

name: Stablecoin supply impulse — execution-aware
mechanism: supply-growth rule decided weekly

name: Miner inventory behavior — event-triggered
mechanism: negative difficulty adjustment (miners capitulated): long BTC for H days

name: Miner inventory behavior — cross-sectional
mechanism: miner stress (hash-price at 1-year low quartile) -> long alts / short BTC (miners sell BTC)

name: Miner inventory behavior — time-series
mechanism: hash ribbons: 30-day hash-rate average crosses back above the 60-day after capitulation -> long BTC for H days

name: Miner inventory behavior — lead-lag
mechanism: hash-rate growth over 90 days (miner investment) leads price: long BTC when positive

name: Miner inventory behavior — regime-conditioned
mechanism: hash-ribbon buy only when BTC is below its 200-day average (bear-market capitulation)

name: Miner inventory behavior — term-structure
mechanism: difficulty ribbon: long BTC when the 9-day difficulty average is above the 90-day (expansion), flat when compressed

name: Miner inventory behavior — flow-based
mechanism: miner revenue (USD) collapse: 30-day revenue below k x its 1-year average -> forced selling done -> long

name: Miner inventory behavior — relative-value
mechanism: hash-price (revenue per unit hash) z-score: low (miners squeezed) -> long, high -> flat

name: Miner inventory behavior — volatility-based
mechanism: hash-rate growth signal only when BTC vol is below its median

name: Miner inventory behavior — execution-aware
mechanism: hash-rate growth signal decided monthly
